name: Flanking
description:
When you and one or more allies are adjacent to the same creature, each of you gains +1d to attack rolls against that creature.

Describe how you surround them.

improvements.name: Team Strike
improvements.description: You and flanking allies also take +1d to damage rolls against the flanked creature.

improvements.name: Topple
improvements.description: When you or a flanking ally lands a hit with a melee attack, another flanking ally may roll Strength vs Dexterity against the flanked creature. On a win, the creature is knocked prone.
